name: What is a rough-in plumbing inspection for a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is a rough-in plumbing inspection for a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A rough-in plumbing inspection occurs after all new pipes, drains, and vents are installed but before walls and floors are covered. An inspector verifies that all plumbing work complies with local building codes and safety standards. This is a critical step in a kitchen remodel to ensure the system is correctly installed and ready for final fixtures and finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: It's an inspection of new pipes, drains, and vents before walls are covered, ensuring compliance with building codes.
